column1: # Headless Node — Unexpected Maker FeatherS3 / FeatherS3[D] — 16 MB flash.
# Golden factory recovery + one 4.5 MiB main slot. Direct recovery HTTP writes
# ota_0; it never needs enough LittleFS space to stage the firmware image.
# The signed release gate is 4 MiB
# This deployment has its own identity and layout. Installing it replaces the
# generic FeatherS3 LittleFS geometry and therefore requires a cable migration.
